/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
human=''
def lev(a,b):
 if len(a)<len(b): a,b=b,a
 prev=list(range(len(b)+1))
 for i,ca in enumerate(a,1):
  cur=[i]
  for j,cb in enumerate(b,1):
   cur.append(min(prev[j]+1,cur[-1]+1,prev[j-1]+(ca"'!=cb)))
  prev=cur
 return prev[-1]
for f in ['"'indri_blast.tsv','semjoh_blast.tsv']:
 print(f)
 lines=open(f).read().strip().splitlines()
 for line in lines:
  cols=line.split('\\t')
  if len(cols)<13: continue
  qseq=cols[8]; sseq=cols[9]
  # remove dashes maybe
  print('cols',cols[:6])
  print('qlen',len(qseq),'slen',len(sseq),'gaps',cols[7],'mismatch',cols[5])
  print('q',qseq)
  print('s',sseq)
  print('lev',lev(qseq,sseq))
PY"
